days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Happy to deliver La Vía Láctea for 58 with 10 delivery days - a fair deal we can sign right away.

Thank you so much for meeting with us — we'd be glad to offer 16 for the card, with delivery on the day we've proposed. Our purse is a little tight this round, but we'd truly love to make this work with you.
We really appreciate your patience and how kindly you've handled this. We can stretch to 23 for La Vía Láctea with delivery on day 10, and we'd be so grateful to close this together.
Thanks for the offer! We can come down to 55 with delivery in 10 days, which is a fair price for La Vía Láctea.
